zh: 直接用浮点数相加再向下取整很危险：像 0.10000001 + 0.89999999 这样恰好等于整数的和，可能被浮点误差算成略小于 1。
输入最多 8 位小数，把每个数乘以 10^8 就变成精确的整数；两个整数相加后再整除 10^8，就是原和的下取整。
把每个数按小数点拆成整数部分和小数部分，小数部分右侧补零到 8 位（没有小数点时视为 0），得到整数部分乘 10^8 加小数部分。两数相加后整除 10^8 输出。数值不超过约 2×10^14，用 64 位整数。
en: Adding as floating point and then flooring is risky: a sum that is exactly an integer, like 0.10000001 + 0.89999999, may come out slightly below 1 because of rounding error.
The inputs have at most 8 decimal places, so multiplying each by 10^8 gives an exact integer; adding the two integers and dividing by 10^8 with integer division gives the floor of the original sum.

Split each number at the decimal point into an integer part and a fractional part, pad the fractional part on the right with zeros to 8 digits (treat it as 0 when there is no point), and form integer part times 10^8 plus fractional part. Add the two values and print the sum divided by 10^8 with integer division. Values stay below about 2x10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Pad each decimal to 8 decimal places and convert it to an integer, add the integers, then divide by 10^8.

## Proof of correctness

After multiplying by 10^8, every valid input is an exact integer; adding the integers and then dividing down by 10^8 gives exactly the floor of the original sum, with none of the rounding issues floating point has near integers.

## Complexity

O(input length) time, O(1) numeric space.
